nom: TONYMOLY Green Tea Superlight Daily Defense Sun Screen SPF 50

avis.texte: I am almost finished with this bottle. I absolutely love this sunscreen. It works great under every foundation that I have tried. It's moisturizing and doesn't leave a white cast on my face. I don't notice a strong sunscreen smell either. Also it doesn't burn my eyes. I also like the consistency, it doesn't feel thick or greasy. I feel that this sunscreen is better than most and will repurchase.

Overall this is a decent sunscreen, it doesn't sting, the smell is neutral, it doesn't feel heavy. It doesn't absorb into my skin it just kinda sits in a thin layer and then I sweat it off immediately

I can tell that this product is good quality and has good ingredients. But it unfortunately makes my eyes sting and water. I am using up the bottle I have, but will not repurchase. I am particularly sensitive to sunscreen, and this is a common issue for me. I am always experimenting to see what sunscreens don't make my eyes water. If you don't have this issue, then it's worth a try.
I really wanted to like this suncreen. I loved the way it felt but left my face extremely red and bumps. And very hot.

I bough this sunscreen in April of this year. Its so beautiful in both texture and wear. No stinging of my eyes. It melts right in. Yet it's moisturizing. Absolutely no white cast. It keeps my skin that is very sun sensitive and burns easily. Protected. Will always buy this sunscreen.

i use this daily as part of my morning skin routine and it doesn't leave a white cast or feel greasy. it sits will under my foundation so have been loving it! gifted by tonymoly in exchange for honest review
It's not a bad sunscreen, it's good for sensitive skin but it's a little bit too oily for my combo skin. I would recommend but not for anyone with combo/oily acne prone skin.

I have dry and sensitive skin and this didn't irritate my skin. Love how this sunscreen feels on, it doesn't leave my face feeling greasy and sticky. I like that there isn't a white cast after applying and looks good with my makeup. It leaves my face feeling hydrated and dewy.

I was gifted by tonymoly and wow, this product did not disappoint! It was so light and hydrating and kept my skin protected. It also smells good! I will definitely be recommending this to anyone looking for some!

I'm so impressed with this sunscreen! The price is so good, and it's lightweight, leaves no white cast and doesn't pill or bunch up on my skin. It's not overly fragranced and doesn't burn my eyes. Such a great product that's truly comparable to my favorite Korean spfs. This was gifted by Tony Moly for an honest review.

Complimentary from tonymoly. I recently tried a new SPF cream, and it pleasantly surprised me! First of all, the texture is lightweight — it absorbs quickly, leaves no white cast or greasy shine. It works perfectly as a makeup base. Secondly, my skin feels hydrated, non-sticky, and it doesn't clog pores or cause irritation (and my skin is quite sensitive). Another bonus — it has a pleasant, subtle scent and comes in convenient packaging.

Wearing sunscreen every is an essential part of my daily routine, and I have tried many different options and I'm in love with this one it don sent make my skin oily, and it's really hydrating and sensitive skin safe gifted by tontmoly

Wow! Green tea is new to me for skincare and I love it. I have sensitive skin and this really was soothing and gentle for me. I appreciate the ingredients used and my skin feels nourished and hydrated. Gifted by tonymoly.

This is now my go-to for daily SPF and skin protection! It doesn't pill with other formulas, lasts on my skin, and has virtually zero white cast. I also haven't had any breakouts or redness from it, even with sensitive skin. Gifted by TM.

Complimentary from tonymoly. This product is lightweight and is great coverage against the sun. I use this before applying foundation and it looks great. I also love how the product is spf 50. Great product!

Been loving this sunscreen lately. It's super lightweight and doesn't leave a white cast at all. Wears well under makeup and feels more like skincare than SPF. No breakouts either which is rare for me. Gifted by tonymoly

I love this sunscreen because it protects my skin. It also hydrates, calms, and soothes my skin. I like that the texture is non-greasy and lightweight. I have medium tan skin and it does not leave a white cast. This was complimentary from TONYMOLY.

Love this sunscreen! I use it on my face daily and it keeps my skin hydrated. It's also lightweight which is reallly important to me when looking for face products. It does not leave a white cast either! Gifted by tonymoly
i love this! finally a sunscreen that works well under makeup, worth the price

avis.titre: One of the best sunscreens Ive used
avis.texte: This sunscreen is hydrating but not greasy. Its so good on my oily skin and it leaves you dewy. Its lightweight and feels good on the skin. It wears beautifully under makeup.
This sunscreen gives you a glow without feeling easy. Its also hydrating and easy to blend into the skin without the white cast. Its also sensitive skin friendly.

I do like that it is spf 50! However it does feel like it has a thicker consistency and not super lightweight which is my preference. It def does the job and does leave a dewy finish. Not a bad spf just wouldn't purchase it again since zi wasn't in love with it.

avis.titre: Very Hydrating with Good SPF Protection
avis.texte: I have found that a little goes a long way with this sunscreen. It blends down without leaving a white cast and leaves my face feeling very hydrated and dewy. But if you add just a little too much and I am left feeling greasy. On days I won't be sweating and want extra moisture this works great!!

avis.titre: Horrible breakout but I really wanted to love it
avis.texte: I started using this sunscreen a couple of months ago & initially had no issues but its started breaking my face out really badly all of a sudden :( it also does it when it put it on my neck or chest. Up until the breakout, it was my new fave, ironically, so thinking its just suited best for people that dont have sensitive and/or oily skin. Despite the name, there is no green tea fragrance but it does have a very mild sunscreen scent that is pleasant.

I LOVE this sunscreen! It does a wonderful job of protecting my skin from the sun, and it leaves it feeling soft and smooth. I also love the benefits of the Green Tea included. So happy to say I've found a sunscreen I love!

I LOVE this sunscreen! It does a wonderful job of protecting my skin from the sun, and I love the benefits of Green Tea included. It also leaves my skin feeling soft and smooth. I am thrilled to say I've finally found a sunscreen I love!

I'm running low on the MakePrem sun cream I've used for the last year, and atarted the search for a new Korean sunscreen that's cheaper to get in the US. Found this in the Korean skincare section and tried it - not a fan. The formula is thick and greasy and it burned my eyes like most susnscreens. I tried it twice, and had little break outs each time. The only pro is it leaves only a LITTLE BIT of a white cast (I'm white, and decently pale so that's not really a pro). I'll stick with paying triple for the brand im cutrently using.

I bought this hoping it could be similar to the Beauty of Joseon sunscreen, but I was very disappointed. It's insanely greasy and thick, like I'd just covered my face in vaseline, and I could feel it sitting on my face. Any powder I applied to it would soak in and I'd look greasy again right away. This might work if you have very dry skin, but it did not work for my combo skin. I use it on my arms now which is tolerable.

The formula is fine and all but ive been spoiled by korean sunscreen and wanted to find an alternative thats more convenient. However the typical "sunscreen smell" is STRONG with this one. I've washed my hands hours after and it still lingers

I defided to give this a try when it went on sale a while back. I absolutely loved it! It doesn't burn my eyes or make them irritated, there's no white cast, and it doesn't make my fungal acne worse. It is very glowy so I powder when I'm just wearing this on its own, so if you have oily skin like me beware.

I defided to give this a try when it went on sale a while back. I absolutely loved it! It doesn't burn my eyes or make them irritated, there's no white cast, and it doesn't make my fungal acne worse. It is very glowy so I powder when I'm just wearing this on its own, so if you have oily skin like me beware.

The best sunscreen in market, I've used several other brands but none of them worked so well on my skin. It is non greasy, no white cast and leaves my skin very smooth. I'm not switching to other sunscreen.

Price point is great, but if you have extremely oily skin like I do, stay far away. If I were not wearing makeup, this would be… fine, but I had to dab my face, then powder it before applying makeup because the residue was oozing. This would probably be best for someone with much drier skin.

avis.titre: I would buy again and again!
avis.texte: I'm new to the whole sunscreen thing and was worried about trying it. I love this one so much, I wear makeup and it works very well with it. It works well with all my skincare products too! I've already recommended it to my friends.

i do enjoy this spf, as someone with acne prone oily skin, i get nervous trying sunscreens because usually thats what breaks me out. This spf does have a tinge of that chemically spf smell, but its not noticeable once it goes on, and it provides a nice glow as well. I recommend!!

I've used the Cetaphil Daily SPF 50 Moisturizer, Laroche Posay Double Repair SPF 30, and the viral Skin 1004 Cica Sun Serum, but this one is the best. It makes my skin feel great and look great. I had no irritation, break outs, or pilling. This should be talked about more!!!

I have dry and slightly senstive skin. My pores clog easily. I previosuky have been using La Rosche Posay face sunscreen (and have tried many others). This is my favorite i have tried. Price is great, is slightly hydrating, no strong white cast, and thin enough to not make my face feel greasy or clogged. I love it also has skincare properties in it. Definitley a must try if youre looking for a good everyday face sunscreen!

I have dry and slightly senstive skin. My pores clog easily. I previosuky have been using La Rosche Posay face sunscreen (and have tried many others). This is my favorite i have tried. Price is great, is slightly hydrating, no strong white cast, and thin enough to not make my face feel greasy or clogged. I love it also has skincare properties in it. Definitley a must try if youre looking for a good everyday face sunscreen!

avis.titre: the BEST sunscreen I have ever used
avis.texte: I have combo skin and all the sunscreens I have used made me feel so oily! They have exemplified the oil on my forehead especially! I used this tonymoly one for the first time and it does not make my forehead super oily or any other areas. It also doubles as a makeup primer which is really cool. I bought this on sale and I would definitely buy this again!

Well I finally figured out that I am allergic to one or multiple ingredients in chemical sunscreens. This sunscreen unfortunately had one of those ingredients and made my eyes burn and water constantly. I do have to give it to the product because there was little to no scent and the feeling on my face was light and gentle, but it just happened to not work for my skin.

i ran out of my innisfree sunscreen so i gave this a try with very little reviews. AMAZING sunscreen. doesn't sting my eyes, and a lot of sunscreens do. feels moisturizing afterwards and easy to blend. same price as innisfree but ulta is closer to me so im glad i found a new sunscreen to pick up! new favorite ❤️

The spf is actually really nice! It's super lightweight, blends in easily, and no white cast—which is always a win. It's got green tea extract, so it's not just sun protection but also a little extra antioxidant boost for your skin. It feels hydrating but not greasy, so if you have combo or dry skin, you'll probably love it. Plus, it has niacinamide and panthenol, which help soothe and brighten. Overall, it's a solid daily sunscreen that sits well under makeup and keeps your skin happy!
I really love the feel of the sunscreen. It applies really well no white cast feels very hydrating and moisturizing. Glad I found it and would re-purchase! it's also a nice price range
It was so smooth and didn't leave a white cast! I loved how light it felt on my skin!
I am so happy that I've finally found a good sunscreen! This cream has zero white casts, non greasy and so lightweight! Andy skin is literally glowing! Highly recommend get yours now!
Great ingredients! Has no whitecast and takes little effort to blend in. I love that it is not scented and doesn't feel thick on the skin :)
I love this sunscreen! It's so hydrating for my dry skin and it doesn't leave a white cast like other sunscreens so! It doesn't break me out out, and is so easy to blend out!
Finally I found a sunscreen with no white cast and sooo moisturizing! I can't believe how good it looks on my face 😍 Absolutely stunning! Highly highly recommended!!!
I love the glow it gives me. The ingredients do not irritate my skin, and the finish is lightweight and not greasy. Would recommend, especially for dry and combination skin types.

avis.titre: Perfect, everyday sunscreen for sensitive, acne-prone skin
avis.texte: Super lightweight, hydrating formula that gives a natural, radiant glow without the greasiness and stickiness. Blends seamlessly with no white cast! It has a slight sunscreen fragrance that dissipates after a while.
Doesnt burn the eyes and so easy to apply. No white cast and blends in fast!

I love this sunscreen! It makes my skin feel so hydrated and refreshed and doesn't leave any white cast. It honestly just feels like face cream that's non-sticky. I also love how it's infused with green tea antioxidants and enriched with vitamin E and panthenol.
I love this spf is super lightweight and non grease,love the scent and how my skin feels moisturizing without leaving a whitecast.whitewash.Blends so easy on the skin.
i love how light this is on my skin! it gives my skin such a healthy natural glow before makeup

avis.titre: No white cast and blends smoothly
avis.texte: This sunscreen has no white cast and it is not sticky or greasy at all. I love how lightweight it is - it feels like nothing on my skin. I also love how glowy and hydrated my skin looks after. Protect your skin against UVA and UVB!
I have sensitive & dry skin and this sunscreen is so lightweight, calming & extremely moisturizing! I use it every day now and I'm just about to purchase another!

avis.titre: The smoothest sunscreen Ive ever tried!
avis.texte: This is literally the smoothest sunscreen I've ever had! It doesn't leave a white cast, blends great on my skin, doesn't leave a greasy effect, and provides so much nourishment to my skin. I've tried many, and this is one of my favorites!

This sunscreen is a game-changer! It's super lightweight, non-greasy, and leaves no white cast - perfect for daily wear. The SPF 50 protection keeps my skin safe, while the green tea, niacinamide, and vitamin E keep it hydrated and fresh. It blends effortlessly, wears well under makeup, and feels like nothing on my skin. If you struggle with heavy or sticky sunscreens, this one is a must-try! Highly recommend!

I've been on the search for a Korean Sunscreen that is affordable and lightweight but also sold in US stores ever since other big korean brands have stopped selling their korean sunscreens in the US due to unapproved sunscreen filters. This one checked all the boxes - no white cast, not greasy, SPF 50 protection, and hydrating! It worked well under my makeup too.
I am in love with tjis SPF, it is super lightweight and ir does nor feel heavy on mt skin. It also leave my skin glowing. I just love it as a priner for my makeup too !

Ugh i havent been this obsessed with a skincare product in aWHILE! I really need everyone to go pick up this sunscreen at ulta so its always in stock!! My local ultas tonymoly section has gotten so small and i dont want this going away. Just trust, this thing is amazing!!

It is currently winter where I live, so I'm reviewing this product based on formulaic elements. This product did not leave a white cast and blends with ease. It did not feel very heavy on my skin like some sunscreens do. In terms of application, I have no complaints! This product was gifted by tonymoly for review.

I like how light this sunscreen feels and it doesn't create any peeling after I apply my foundation on which happens a lot with many sunscreens I've tried. I love the smell it has a very fresh scent. Definitely going on my list of good sunscreens. Gifted by tonymoly

I have been waiting for TonyMoly to create a proper sunscreen since I have fallen in love with all of the products I have tried from them, and none have broken me out or given me any headaches— easy on the mind and wallet. I haven't had this for too long, but the last couple of days my skin has felt so much lighter during the daytime. I had used another essence sunscreen from Ulta as I'm trying to keep buying what is available in the US vs trying to battle the wait times for some K-beauty stores overseas, but this will be on repeat and haul restock lists for quite some time for me.

I found the ONE! This sun screen is so light weight, glides on so smooth, dewy with a silky finish. I love that it has skincare ingredients and makes applying sun screen so enjoyable! Love love this product, HIGHLY recommend!

This sunscreen is an absolute game-changer! It leaves no white cast at all—I have a mocha complexion, and it blends seamlessly. It's super hydrating, gives my skin a beautiful glow, and feels incredibly lightweight. I highly recommend adding this to your skincare routine. A 10/10 for me!

I am a huge fan of this green tea sunscreen. It has SPF 50 which is great for protecting my skin from burns. I also like how it applies onto the skin without leaving thick white streaks. Complimentary from Tonymoly.

This sunscreen is super light and easy to use. It doesn't clog my pores and a little bit of product also goes a long way. The ingredients in it are also great for the skin as well. Would definitely recommend, Gifted by tonymoly.

Gifted by tonymoly. Love this sunscreen and that there's no whitecast! Goes on great without irritating my skin and is perfect for building with makeup overtop. Gentle enough on sensitive skin and not oily at all, perfect for everyday.

I love this brand from my time in Korea they are the real deal and their products are so smoothing and comforting. This one is the same, I think it really layers into skin beautifully I'm quite a fan!! Complimentary from tonymoly

It's lightweight, non-greasy, and PERFECT for everyday use. It absorbs and melts into my skin is so nice. It leaves no white coating. I love this sunscreen because it's perfect. It has all the features I want in a sunscreen. gifted by tonymoly

I gave this sunblock gifted by tonymoly a try and I have to say it was better than my expectation. My issue with sunscreen is they feel heavy and sticky on my skin but this one is not and feels extremely light and easy to apply on the skin
UGh i LOVE this sunscreen! i just love how it applies, theres no white cast, aborbs quickly and leaves me dewy not oily or shiny looking. this is definitely going straight into my sunscreen rotation.
